The '''Organa Vinerium''' was a farm on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Located on the [[Apalis Coast]], it served as the farm facilities for [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] where they made their wine, and was served by the nearby [[Apalis Fields]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Empire-allied [[House of Thul|House Thul]] occupied the Vinerium during the [[Alderaan Civil War]] as a staging ground against the Republic-allied House Organa's [[Castle Organa|palace]]. A Republic-allied individual destroyed House Thul's illegal [[CryoBan grenade/Legends|CryoBan]] technology and drove back the Thul forces from the Vinerium, defeating the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]] that the Empire had sent to aid House Thul. Thanks to the individual's efforts, House Organa and the Republic were able to reclaim the Vinerium and push back the enemy from the coast.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Organa Vinerium was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It appears on the Apalis Coast region of Alderaan, and features in several missions for Republic players.<ref name="TOR" />
